import os
os.chdir(r'C:\Users\shrey\Desktop\Elemental_harness')


def edit(p, pairs):
    s = open(p, encoding='utf8').read()
    for a, b in pairs:
        assert s.count(a) == 1, (p, a[:70])
        s = s.replace(a, b)
    open(p, 'w', encoding='utf8', newline='\n').write(s)


edit('scripts/eval/claude-code.ts', [
    ("  readonly message?: { readonly id?: string; readonly content?: unknown }",
     "  readonly message?: { readonly id?: string; readonly model?: string; readonly content?: unknown }"),
    (" * @returns harness-shaped events, total usage, the final text, and the error text of a failed run.\n */\nexport function parseClaudeCodeOutput(stdout: string): { events: EvalEvent[]; usage?: EvalUsage; output?: string; error?: string } {",
     " * @returns harness-shaped events, total usage, the final text, the error text of a failed run,\n *   and the model the endpoint says answered, which shows whether a run really used the model asked for.\n */\nexport function parseClaudeCodeOutput(stdout: string): { events: EvalEvent[]; usage?: EvalUsage; output?: string; error?: string; model?: string } {"),
    ("  let error: string | undefined\n", "  let error: string | undefined\n  let model: string | undefined\n"),
    ("      const id = row.message?.id\n", "      model ??= row.message?.model\n      const id = row.message?.id\n"),
    ("    ...error === undefined ? {} : { error },\n  }", "    ...error === undefined ? {} : { error },\n    ...model === undefined ? {} : { model },\n  }"),
])

edit('scripts/eval/claude-code.spec.ts', [
    ("  ({ type: 'assistant', parent_tool_use_id: parent, message: { id, content } })",
     "  ({ type: 'assistant', parent_tool_use_id: parent, message: { id, model: 'qwen3-coder-next', content } })"),
    ("    expect(parsed.error).toBeUndefined()\n", "    expect(parsed.error).toBeUndefined()\n    expect(parsed.model).toBe('qwen3-coder-next')\n"),
])

edit('scripts/eval/run-eval.ts', [
    ("  readonly finalText?: string\n  readonly note?: string\n}",
     "  readonly finalText?: string\n  /** Model the endpoint reported answering, when the agent's output names it. */\n  readonly model?: string\n  readonly note?: string\n}"),
    ("      ...run.output === undefined ? {} : { finalText: run.output },",
     "      ...run.output === undefined ? {} : { finalText: run.output },\n      ...run.model === undefined ? {} : { model: run.model },"),
    ("  /** Why the run failed before finishing, e.g. a provider rejecting every request. */\n  readonly error?: string\n}",
     "  /** Why the run failed before finishing, e.g. a provider rejecting every request. */\n  readonly error?: string\n  readonly model?: string\n}"),
])

edit('scripts/eval/README.md', [
    ("pnpm run eval:file-finding -- --repo <path-to-repo> --hard --limit 6 --agent claude-code --claude-model sonnet\n```",
     "pnpm run eval:file-finding -- --repo <path-to-repo> --hard --limit 6 --agent claude-code --claude-model sonnet\n\n# Claude Code on the same provider and model as the harness.\npnpm run eval:file-finding -- --repo <path-to-repo> --hard --limit 6 --agent claude-code --home-from ~/.dsh --claude-provider <provider id> --claude-model <model id>\n```"),
    ("It authenticates however your `claude` does; set `ANTHROPIC_BASE_URL` and `ANTHROPIC_AUTH_TOKEN` to point it at another Anthropic-compatible endpoint.",
     "It authenticates however your `claude` does, unless `--claude-provider` names a provider from the `--home-from` DSH home: then it uses that provider's base URL and key, and every model tier and subagent runs `--claude-model`. The provider must also serve the Anthropic Messages API (`/v1/messages`), as OmniRoute does. `<task>.json` records the model the endpoint reported answering."),
])
print('ok')
